title: Guided filing journey — ANDS Studio
walkthrough:
You land on a page with a top bar branded "ANDS Studio · guided ANDS filing" and chips for "Help", "My dossiers", "Portfolio", "Registry", and "Correspondence". If you have never acknowledged it, a "Before you start · external prerequisites" card shows first: "Two things Health Canada must issue you" lists the 5-digit Company ID (chip "lead time ~2 weeks", enrol by emailing a Company Template to hc.osip-bpip.sc@canada.ca) and the permanent Dossier ID (chip "issued on request via REP", request at most 8 weeks before filing). Each carries a citation line and an "HC guidance ↗" link. You click "I understand — begin the journey →" (reopenable from Help).

The hero headline reads "File your ANDS with Health Canada — guided end to end." A paragraph explains an Abbreviated New Drug Submission is one of the most complex filings a company can make and that this walks you through it step by step. You click "Start my submission →" ("Starting…" while working); a second link reads "Or open your dossiers — every product in submission →". A footnote says "Grounded in real Health Canada process · your progress is saved automatically".

The screen then splits into three: a left "Your filing journey" rail of steps; a center step card headed "Step N of 10"; and a right panel. That panel's module view opens on a toggle (chips "3D view" / "Checklist"); the Checklist is a plain printable table mapping M1–M5 to the Health Canada requirement each satisfies, with a Status and Outstanding column — Module 4 reads "Nonclinical study reports — not required for a generic ANDS". Below sits a "Readiness" card showing "● READY TO FILE" or "● BLOCKED", the line "X of Y filing steps complete (Z% of the tracked filing checklist)", and beneath it "Checked against <profile> v<version> — structural completeness, not HC's official eValidator" with a "Rule catalogue" toggle and a "How is Z% measured?" expander. A progress bar and, when blocked, "The single thing standing between you and ready:" with a resume button follow.

Step 1 ("Tell me about your drug") teaches the ANDS pathway and shows the drug-intake form. Later steps collect "Your Health Canada Company ID" (placeholder "e.g. 12345"; a "I've requested it — flag as an open risk & continue →" control, after which a warning notice says the ID stays pending and you cannot transmit until the real 5-digit ID is set) and a "Dossier ID" (placeholder "e123456"; blurring validates it: "✓ Valid Dossier ID format."). The submission step pre-fills "Drug product" and asks "Applicant (your company name)".

The content step links "Open the Module builder →"; the Continue button stays disabled with "Place the required documents to continue" until "✓ All required documents are in — you can continue." Validation reports "✓ Validation passed…" or "✗ N error(s) to fix". A fees checkbox reads "My small-business status is already granted"; then QA review, e-signature, and transmit. The transmit step teaches CESG and, by default, shows one line — "Transmission receipts: N of 3 received" — with a "Show the three receipts" expander revealing the FDA-ESG explanation and three tiles (FDA MDN, FDA ACK, HC ACK (Core ID)). The final step explains screening (~45 days), review (~180 days), and NOC/NOD/NON outcomes. The top bar shows a live "Z% ready" or "Ready to file" chip and "Start over".
